items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Well, you talk to Pete Fonten, Pete Fonten thinks he's the greatest. He's a great player, and Pete Fonten likes for Zola.

ctx.x: Well, nobody now understands that style of tenor playing except, I mean, people now don't appreciate what he was doing in a tenor.

Well, you talk to Pete Fonten, Pete Fonten thinks he's the greatest. He's a great player, and Pete Fonten likes for Zola. Yeah. Well, listen, a lot of clients, they play like Lester Bouchon, because listen, Lester can play, he can play Gut Bucket.
He can play some nice bass sax, too.
